title: ChatGPT Code Review Prompt
prompt:
Review the following code for bugs, performance issues, and readability. For each issue found, explain why it's a problem and suggest a fix. Then provide the improved code.

```
[PASTE YOUR CODE HERE]
```

title: Claude Long Document Summary
prompt:
Summarize the following document into 5 key points, each with a one-sentence explanation. Then list 3 action items if applicable.

[PASTE YOUR DOCUMENT HERE]

title: Midjourney Cinematic Portrait
prompt: cinematic portrait of [SUBJECT], dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, shot on 85mm lens, golden hour, film grain, ultra detailed --ar 4:5 --style raw --v 6

title: Cursor Agent Refactor Prompt
prompt: Refactor this function into 3 smaller, well-named functions. Extract the data fetching logic, the transformation logic, and the rendering logic. Add TypeScript types. Keep the same external API.

title: Gemini Research Summary
prompt: Research [TOPIC] and provide: 1) A 3-paragraph summary, 2) 5 key findings with sources, 3) 3 counterarguments, 4) Recommended next steps. Cite all sources.

title: AI Blog Introduction Writer
prompt: Write a compelling blog post introduction (150 words) about [TOPIC]. Start with a surprising statistic or question. End with a clear thesis statement. Tone: authoritative but approachable.

title: Cold Email Outreach Prompt
prompt: Write a cold email to [PERSON] at [COMPANY] about [PRODUCT/SERVICE]. Keep it under 100 words. Start with their specific pain point. End with a single clear CTA. No buzzwords.

title: Midjourney Product Photography
prompt: professional product photography of [PRODUCT], on marble surface, soft studio lighting, shallow depth of field, commercial quality, 50mm lens, white background --ar 1:1 --style raw --v 6

title: Claude Contract Analysis
prompt:
Analyze this contract for: 1) Unusual clauses, 2) Missing standard protections, 3) Liability risks, 4) Termination conditions. Flag each issue with severity (low/medium/high).

[PASTE CONTRACT HERE]

title: Meta Prompt Engineering
prompt: I want to create a prompt for [TASK]. Help me design it by: 1) Defining the role the AI should play, 2) Specifying the exact output format, 3) Listing 3 constraints, 4) Providing 2 few-shot examples. Output the final prompt in a code block.

title: Cursor Bug Fix Prompt
prompt: This code has a bug: [DESCRIBE THE BUG]. The expected behavior is: [DESCRIBE EXPECTED]. Find the root cause, fix it, and explain what was wrong. Add a test that would have caught this bug.

title: Suno Song Prompt
prompt: An upbeat indie folk song about [THEME], with acoustic guitar, hand claps, and a catchy chorus. Male vocals, warm production, 120 BPM, key of C major.

title: ElevenLabs Narration Script
prompt: In a calm, professional narrator voice: Welcome to [PRODUCT NAME]. In the next 60 seconds, I'll show you how to [KEY BENEFIT]. First, [STEP 1]. Then, [STEP 2]. Finally, [STEP 3]. That's it. Try it now at [URL].

title: Flux Photorealistic Product Shot
prompt: photorealistic product photograph of [PRODUCT], natural window light, shallow depth of field, marble countertop, warm tones, shot on 50mm f/1.8, ultra detailed, no text

title: Gamma Presentation Prompt
prompt: Create a 10-slide product proposal for [PRODUCT]. Audience: [STAKEHOLDERS]. Include: problem, solution, market size, competitive landscape, go-to-market, pricing, team, timeline, ask. Keep each slide to 3 bullet points max.

title: ChatGPT Data Analysis Prompt
prompt:
Analyze this dataset and provide: 1) Key statistics (mean, median, std dev), 2) 3 notable trends or patterns, 3) 2 anomalies or outliers, 4) A recommended visualization. Format as a brief report.

[PASTE DATA HERE]

title: Ideogram Poster Prompt
prompt: A bold event poster for [EVENT NAME] on [DATE]. Large readable text saying '[EVENT NAME]'. Modern minimalist design, geometric shapes, vibrant accent color. No stock photos.

title: Claude Essay Outline
prompt: Create a detailed outline for an essay about [TOPIC]. Include: thesis statement, 4-5 main arguments (each with 2 supporting points), counterargument section, and conclusion. Use academic tone.

title: Perplexity Research Prompt
prompt: What are the top [NUMBER] [TOPIC] in 2026? For each, provide: name, key features, pricing, best use case, and a source link. Focus on tools available globally.

title: Kling Chinese Video Prompt
